description: List guest-messaging threads for an agency or one lead, with participants and read status. Give lead_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/threads.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

name: hostfully_list_threads
title: List message threads
